name: Conserva de Saudade

name: Mil Folhas
description: A pastry-paper composition with a scalloped portrait mat, stacked fine edges and a broad italic heading.

name: Maré à Mesa

name: Tasca das Horas

name: Nata de Domingo

name: Linha de Mercado

name: Doce Recado

name: Mesa Reservada

name: Migalha

name: Beijinho de Canela
description: A compact cinnamon-kiss note with a round portrait at the right and a tiny crossed-spice detail.

name: Sal de Mar
description: A miniature wavy salt label with a diamond seal and a short centred title.

name: Gota de Azeite
description: A spare note with a droplet portrait, a thin pouring line and a small name set against the frame.

name: Última Colher
description: A petite dessert card with two small square portraits beside a spoon-shaped divider beneath the reply.
